items.title: Chambers and Valves of Heart (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Chambers and Valves of Heart: a main subheading of 11.1 Structure and functioning of the heart, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 236-237.

blocks.text: Dil ke chaar khane (chambers) hain: oopar do patli deewar wale atria (wahid: atrium) aur neeche do moti deewar wale ventricles. Atria jism se khoon lete hain aur ventricles ko dete hain; ventricles khoon ko jism mein bhejte hain. Atria aur ventricles ke beech atrioventricular septum (parda) hai. Baen aur daen atria ke beech interatrial septum hai. Isi tarah baen aur daen ventricles ke beech interventricular septum hai, jo interatrial septum se kahin zyada mota hai.

Ventricles ke andar aane ke raston par (atrioventricular septum mein) do atrioventricular valves hain: tricuspid valve aur bicuspid valve. Tricuspid valve (teen flaps ya cusps wala) daen atrium aur daen ventricle ke beech hai. Bicuspid (mitral) valve (do cusps wala) baen atrium aur baen ventricle ke beech hai. Jab ventricles sukarte (contract hote) hain to tricuspid aur bicuspid valves band ho jate hain aur khoon ko wapas atria mein jane se rokte hain.

Ventricles se bahar nikalne ke raston par do semilunar valves hain (in ki shakal aadhe chand jaisi hoti hai). Inhen pulmonary valve aur aortic valve kehte hain. Pulmonary valve pulmonary artery ki jar (base) par aur aortic valve aorta ki jar par hai. Jab ventricles dheele (relax) hote hain to pulmonary aur aortic valves band ho jate hain. Is tarah yeh khoon ko pulmonary artery aur aorta se wapas ventricles mein aane se rokte hain.

blocks.alt: Dil ki qash. Superior aur inferior vena cava neela khoon right atrium mein late hain; woh tricuspid valve se right ventricle mein, phir pulmonary valve se pulmonary trunk mein jata hai. Left atrium ka surkh khoon bicuspid valve se left ventricle mein aur aortic valve se aorta mein jata hai. Septum dono hisson ko alag karta hai. Inset mein chaaron valves oopar se dikhaye gaye hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tricuspid aur bicuspid valves atria aur ventricles ke beech hain; pulmonary aur aortic (semilunar) valves ventricles se nikalne wali badi naliyon ke shuru mein hain. Teer khoon ka rukh dikhate hain.
